title: DeterministicRule
description: A PROMOTED, ACTIVE deterministic rule that now runs FIRST on its scope, with an LLM/human/hold-out fallback for uncertain cases. It is the M7 artifact: a RuleCandidate that passed replay + shadow + the promotion gate. It pins the executable rule body, the scope it owns, the REQUIRED fallback_policy (deterministic-first then fallback — no active rule without one), the promotion_receipt_id that warranted activation, and the lossless distilled_from_trace_ids it was distilled from (NEVER deleted — the LLM/consensus/adjudication traces remain rehydratable). For a truth_serving rule the gate guarantees unsafe_false_positives==0. This rule does NOT create a second reconciliation/optimizer authority: a reconciliation/conflict rule ASSERTS-EQUIVALENCE to the existing Baltor golden, it reproduces it. Deterministic when activated_at is injected.

rule_id.description: stable rule id (version lives in metadata, never in the id); content-addressed over the rule_body

rule_version.description: version in metadata, not in the id

source_scope.description: a global_public rule must have been distilled only from non-tenant_private (or anonymized+approved) traces

scope.description: the slice this rule owns (narrow); outside scope it does not fire

status.description: a DeterministicRule exists only once promoted; M8 retire flips status=retired (rule kept, fallback owns the path)

active.description: true while the rule runs first on its scope; false when retired/disabled

fallback_policy.description: REQUIRED — deterministic-first then fallback; an active rule without a fallback is invalid (gate enforces)

promotion_receipt_id.description: the RulePromotionReceipt that warranted activation; without it the rule is not legitimately active

replay_report_id.description: the RuleReplayReport that proved precision on historical verified traces

shadow_report_id.description: the ShadowRunReport that proved no unsafe mismatch live

unsafe_false_positives.description: must be 0 for a truth_serving rule (gate enforces); recorded here for monitoring

distilled_from_trace_ids.description: the LLM/consensus/adjudication traces this rule was distilled from; NEVER deleted (lossless rehydration)

asserts_equivalence_to.description: the existing Baltor golden/authority this rule REPRODUCES (e.g. 'reconciliation:reg-e-beats-faq'); empty for rules that own a new deterministic slice. A reconciliation/conflict rule MUST name the golden it reproduces — it never replaces the authority.

source_handles.description: handles the rule's decisions must preserve when it serves truth

retired_at.description: injected time when retired (M8); empty while active
